title: Triterpenoids From Ilex rotunda and Their Anti-Inflammatory Effects by Interfering With NF-kappaB and MAPK Activation.
authors: Dat Le, Duc; Truong, Vinhquang; Dang, Thinhulinh; Yu, Soojung; Dinh, Thientam; Thao, Nguyen Phuong; Lee, Mina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究冬青属植物三萜类化合物的抗炎作用机制，涉及NF-kappaB和MAPK信号通路，分子对接仅针对炎症相关蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Ilex rotunda is traditionally employed to treat inflammatory diseases. A feature-based molecular network guided the phytochemical investigation of this plant, which resulted in the isolation and identification of two new and nine known compounds. Through the analysis of their mass and spectroscopic data and comparison with those published in the literature, their structures were determined. The isolated compounds were discovered to have anti-inflammatory properties that suppressed the synthesis of nitric oxide mediators and inflammatory cytokines (tumor necrosis factor-alpha [TNF-alpha] production and interleukin-6 [IL-6]). Compound 1 and the new compounds 3 and 6 downregulated the expression levels of the COX-2 and iNOS enzymatic proteins. Furthermore, compounds 3 and 6 were mechanically found to downregulate LPS-stimulated inflammation via NF-kappaB and MAPK inactivation by inhibiting the nuclear translocation of p65 and preventing the phosphorylation of Ikappaalphabeta and ERK kinases. The molecular docking data on binding affinity and interactions with active compounds docked into the targeted proteins supported the above anti-inflammatory effects. We identified the active constituents of I. rotunda that possess anti-inflammatory properties, aiming to develop strategies for treating inflammation.
abstract_zh: 铁冬青（Ilex rotunda）传统上用于治疗炎症性疾病。基于特征的分子网络引导了该植物的植物化学研究，从而分离并鉴定了两个新化合物和九个已知化合物。通过分析其质谱和光谱数据，并与文献中已发表的数据进行比较，确定了它们的结构。发现所分离的化合物具有抗炎特性，可抑制一氧化氮介质和炎症细胞因子（肿瘤坏死因子-α [TNF-alpha] 产生和白细胞介素-6 [IL-6]）的合成。化合物1以及新化合物3和6下调了COX-2和iNOS酶蛋白的表达水平。此外，机制研究发现，化合物3和6通过抑制p65的核转位和阻止Ikappaalphabeta及ERK激酶的磷酸化，经由NF-kappaB和MAPK失活来下调LPS刺激的炎症反应。分子对接数据关于活性化合物与靶蛋白的结合亲和力及相互作用，支持了上述抗炎效果。我们鉴定了铁冬青中具有抗炎特性的活性成分，旨在制定治疗炎症的策略。
